text:
Dr. SU Clinic is an excellent place for anyone dealing with persistent pain. The clinic has a very welcoming atmosphere, and the staff are attentive, organised, and genuinely supportive from the first moment you enter.
Dr. Su is highly qualified in rehabilitation and physical therapy, with advanced training that clearly shows in the way she works. Her approach is modern even cutting edge, precise and based on current scientific methods rather than outdated general techniques. She quickly identifies the real cause of the problem and explains the treatment clearly, without jargon.
In my case, the improvement has been significant. After dealing with long-term pain, her targeted methods finally made progress where other treatments had not.
Dr. Su offers several advanced procedures, including:

Ultrasound-guided dry needling
Extremely precise, even in difficult areas such as around the throat and deep neck muscles.

Ultrasound-guided hydrodissection
A technique where sterile fluid is injected to gently separate stuck or irritated muscle and fascia layers. This reduces friction, decreases pain, and improves mobility. The procedure was done with clarity, caution, and excellent control.

Botox for therapeutic use
Applied to relax overactive muscles when clinically appropriate.

Her level of education, technical skill, and confidence with complex anatomy set her apart from most clinics. You feel that she knows exactly what she is doing, and that gives a lot of trust during the treatment.
Overall, Dr. SU Clinic is professional, science-driven, and very patient-focused. I can fully recommend it to anyone looking for effective and modern pain management in a supportive environment.

Thank you so much to all of you. 🙏🙏🙏
